extDescription.message: Create sound stickers from a video, image, or GIF locally in your browser for use with WhatsApp Web. Unofficial.

logPageTitle.message: Sound Stickers for Web Chat: Log

logPageHint.message: If something goes wrong, download the log to inspect or share when reporting an issue. Phone numbers and IDs are masked.

panelSubtitle.message: Version $p1$ · processed locally in your browser · max 1 MB per sticker

disclaimerFooter.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with or endorsed by WhatsApp or Meta.

unsupportedWebApp.message: This version of the web app is not supported yet

unsupportedHint.message: This version of the web app is not supported yet. Sending is disabled, but you can still create and download .webp and .ogg files.

tabVideoDesc.message: A video with its own sound: trim the clip and keep video and audio synced together.

tabImageDesc.message: A still image with any audio you choose. The sticker lasts as long as the selected audio clip.

tabMixDesc.message: An animation (muted video or GIF) paired with any audio clip you choose.

pickImageHint.message: JPG, PNG, WebP... (a photo, drawing, or meme).

pickAnimHint.message: A video (its sound is ignored) or an animated GIF.

pickAudioHint.message: MP3, M4A, OGG, WAV... or a video to extract sound from.

imageAnimatedNote.message: This is an animated image: only its first frame is used here. For motion, use the "Video or GIF + audio" tab.

errStillImageInMix.message: this is a still image. Use the "Image + audio" tab.

trimVideoHint.message: Drag the handles: the video jumps to each handle's frame. Click or drag the bar to move the playhead.

trimAudioHint.message: Choose where the sound starts and ends. Drag the handles or enter seconds.

trimMixVideoHint.message: Choose the animation clip. This video's audio is not used.

fitFreeze.message: Hold last frame until audio ends

mixPromptSelect.message: Choose an animation and audio to see how long the sticker will last.

mixSameDuration.message: Animation and audio have the same duration: $p1$.

mixIndependentDesc.message: Each keeps its own duration: when tapped, animation and audio start together and end separately. Changing the audio will not require recalculating options.

mixAnimLonger.message: Animation is longer: it will be trimmed to $p1$.

mixFreezeDesc.message: Sticker lasts $p1$: animation pauses on its last frame at $p2$.

testTogetherHint.message: Preview: animation plays once, just like in chat.

calcHint.message: Reads the clip once and estimates file size for each combination.

calcReady.message: Done in $p1$ s. Choose a cell (★ = recommended).

cellExceeds.message: ≈ $p1$ even at minimum quality: exceeds 1 MB

cellLowQ.message: ≈ $p1$ at normal quality: quality will be lowered to fit

noCellFits.message: No combination fits under 1 MB: shorten the clip.

syncOffsetHint.message: Usually 0. If audio lags on some devices, the first frame waits this long.

stillStickerDesc.message: By default the image is sent as a 1-frame animated sticker matching the audio length, which is known to support sound. Check this to test if sound also plays on a static sticker.

metaHint.message: Sticker metadata (optional): shown below the sticker in chat. Saved locally.

staleStickerNote.message: You changed settings after creating this sticker. Click "Recreate sticker with changes"; sending now will send the previous version.

destOpenForward.message: Send to open chat and open Forward

destSelfForward.message: Save to my chat (You) and open Forward

stickerReadyStatus.message: Sticker ready. Check the preview and send it.

sendSuccessForward.message: Sent. Select chats in the Forward dialog.

resInfoSummary.message: $p1$ · $p2$ px$p3$$p4$ · quality $p5$ · sticker $p6$$p7$ · audio $p8$ at $p9$ kbps
